title: Government Unveils Fuel Price Relief Measures Ahead of Elections, Denies Subsidy Return
detail: Nigeria's finance minister announced measures to cushion energy shocks as the country heads toward elections, including a 30-day NNPC petrol discount prioritising public transport operators. The presidency's spokesman dismissed reports of a reintroduced fuel subsidy as fake news, saying the measures are meant to ease pressure without reviving subsidies.

media.caption: Nigeria looks to ease fuel prices as election looms
